headline: Argentina Approves Electricity and Gas Tariff Hikes for December
summary: The Argentine government approved electricity and gas tariff increases exceeding 2% for December, adding pressure to year-end inflation.
why: Regulated utility tariff adjustments directly impact household cost-of-living metrics and headline inflation figures.

impacts.name: Argentina
impacts.why: Utility price increases directly contribute to domestic consumer price inflation.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
